key_type.title: Key type
key_type.description: Which identifier the key column holds: an allow-listed DICOM tag as dicom:<tag> (PatientID, OtherPatientIDs, PatientName, IssuerOfPatientID, AccessionNumber, StudyID). Default: dicom:PatientID.

fill_demographics.title: Fill demographics
fill_demographics.description: Fill a participant's blank date of birth and sex from the stored original DICOM headers. Never overwrites. Default: off.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Header names, e.g. {"key_value": "Pseudonym"}. Each row needs a key and exactly one of alias1 or person_source_value.
